reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Storage version of `secretstores.external-secrets.io` changes v1beta1 → v1", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Existing SecretStore objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update must be done before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all SecretStore objects (storage version migration) and update status.storedVersions on the CRD before v1beta1 is removed.

proposed.statement: The storage version of the secretstores.external-secrets.io CRD moves from v1beta1 to v1, so existing SecretStore objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten, and a storage version migration is needed before a later release removes v1beta1.
